activity_summary: You boarded at her table, one meal at threepence, inside the two or three she allows in a week. The penny loaf sat short of the old notch, and she said you need not make a sermon of a loaf. She said four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner, and that she believes that. Alse said Gib is on the book again, on the page you said you need. Quiet after nine still stands. You did not rehearse on the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, looked at the notch, and did not rehearse.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Counted the threepence, refused a proverb, and named her hours.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set the herring and the loaf, and reported the cat.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Preferred the table to the loom for the length of the meal, then went back.

facets.activity: Sat one meal and let the short loaf be

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: If you are sitting, it is threepence, and it counts.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. That I believe.
